context.task: The shelf is organized while the person speaks on a video call. Give a low-priority update.

options.A: Give a brief spoken update now.

The person asked for brief spoken updates right away when working alone. During a video call, wait until the call ends. This preference applies to low-priority updates. Timing in other situations is unclear.
